actions.script: const view = ec.resource.script('component://tools/template/LoadRuns.js').runView(context.runId, {withTitle: String(context.withTitle) == 'true'}) ec.web.sendJsonResponse(Object.assign({}, view, {errors: view.found ? null : view.error}))

const plan = ec.resource.script('component://tools/template/LoadRuns.js').planForm(context.scriptLocation, context.runId) ec.web.sendJsonResponse(Object.assign({}, plan, {errors: plan.found ? null : plan.error}))

const body = ec.web.secureRequestParameters const started = ec.resource.script('component://tools/template/LoadRuns.js').startRun({scriptLocation: context.scriptLocation, targetKind: context.targetKind, targetUrl: context.targetUrl, label: context.label, insecure: context.insecure, parametersJson: body.parametersJson || '{}', scenariosJson: body.scenariosJson || '{}'}) ec.web.sendJsonResponse({runId: started.runId || null, errors: started.error || null})

const deleted = ec.resource.script('component://tools/template/LoadRuns.js').call('delete#LoadRun', {runId: String(context.runId || '')}) ec.web.sendJsonResponse({deleted: deleted.out.deleted === true, errors: deleted.error})

label.text: Not available: load testing needs the LOAD_RUNNER permission.
